threads.body: The Rediscala project relies on compiler-classpath inference, but the pinned Gradle 9.8.2 recognizes Scala 3 through `scala3-library_3`, not this unified `scala-library` dependency. With this bump, inference requests the sources JAR for `scala3-sbt-bridge:3.10.0` where Zinc needs a compiled bridge, breaking `compileScala` before the Redis scenarios can run. Retain `2.13.18` until the Scala 3 compiler/toolchain configuration is explicitly migrated and validated.

replies.body: Fixed in `b7adf75`. The catalog now declares `scala3-library_3` directly, so Gradle picks the compiled Scala 3 bridge. The Rediscala scenario compiles and still produces the same Redis coverage.
